text:
br-vendor-acme: Hi Redwood team — quick question on the invoice we submitted. Our local tax authority will withhold ~15% IRRF on payments from foreign customers. Can Redwood gross-up the invoice so we still receive the full amount? Invoice #RB-2025-09 attached.

marie-finance: Thanks — can you paste the withholding notice or a reference? Do you have a tax ID (CNPJ) and any certificate of residency?

br-vendor-acme: Sure — CNPJ 12.345.678/0001-90. The note from our accountant: "IRRF sobre serviços prestados por não-residentes — retenção aproximada 15% sobre a fatura." We can request a DARF or withholding slip once payment is processed.

sam-sales: @marie-finance fyi vendor flagged this. Contract language currently says payments are net of taxes, we didn't agree to gross-ups in SOW.

anas-tax: Quick take: we typically don't gross-up for foreign withholding unless contractually required. If the vendor is Brazil-resident, IRRF is their responsibility. Options: 1) pay net as invoiced; 2) vendor issues invoice that shows gross + withheld so they can claim credit locally; 3) case-by-case CFO approval for gross-up for strategic vendors.

leo-legal: Confirming policy: no gross-ups without CFO sign-off and legal sign-off. We should ask vendor for formal proof of withholding (receipt/DARF) and an updated invoice that itemizes the gross amount and the withheld tax. That helps accounting.

marie-finance: Understood. Can you reissue an invoice in USD that clearly shows: gross amount, IRRF withheld (BRL or USD), and net payable? Also upload any withholding certificate once available. Payments team — any technical blockers to paying a reduced/net amount?

payments-bot: Scheduled ACH run tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Manual review will be required to change payment amounts or add gross-up; please submit paperwork before cutoff.

marie-finance: Thanks. @br-vendor-acme please upload the DARF or similar withholding evidence and reissue the invoice with the lines requested. We'll route for CFO sign-off if a gross-up is requested.

br-vendor-acme: Copy — we'll upload the certificate and new invoice within 24h. Appreciate the quick replies :pray:
